title: French wine industry facing historic low harvest after extreme summer heat
caption:
France is facing its smallest wine harvest in decades. While extreme heat and smaller vineyard footprints have driven down total volume, growers say the grapes themselves are in excellent health. A look at how the industry is adapting to a changing climate.

Source: Theguardian - French wine industry facing historic low harvest after extreme summer heat
